title: Craft Blend 3-Mix Duo #25 (L:동심원·매끈 / C:가로 띠·물결)
prompt:
Image format: a landscape-orientation photograph, 3:4 aspect ratio.

A photograph of TWO women standing side by side on a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in the frame, 50mm lens at f/8, a single hard key light raking across all of them from one side, sharp focus head to toe on each — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

Left woman: a real adult Yoruba Nigerian woman in her late 40s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, rich deep brown skin with a golden highlighter on the cheekbones, warm gold and bronze eyeshadow blended up to the brow bone, sharply defined arched brows, a precise winged liner, long dramatic lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, a deep wine-red glossy lip, a large sculpted gele head-wrap of stiff gold-and-cream fabric folded high above her head, a poised, joyful, radiant expression, bold and confident, bold vivid tangerine-orange hair styled in cornrows braided tight against the scalp, real living eyes. Long stiletto nails, glossy finish.

Left woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. Every part of her is dramatically oversized at once: a colossal heavy bust far wider than her shoulders, and below it a waistline that still draws in sharply even at this size. Below that waistline, enormous round hips flare out more than three times the width of the waistline, gigantic soft thighs pressed together, very thick soft arms, a full round face. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Not a plus-size model, an overwhelming maximalist hourglass. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Left woman's body art: Her bare skin is painted with 3 different traditional patterns, each claiming its own region of her figure. Her figure is divided into 3 concentric regions around a single centre point located about 45% of the way down her figure from the top on the centre line of her figure, separated by 2 hazy ring-shaped transition zones at about 22% and 37% of the way out from that centre point to the farthest edge of her figure. Region 1 is the innermost core around the centre point: it is painted in Islamic geometric star-tile pattern (a dense precise pattern of interlocking eight-pointed stars), wide gold bands following the contours of the body, dense geometric star-and-polygon tile filling the space between bands. Region 2 is the ring between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it is painted in American Art Deco chrome-and-lacquer (a deep black lacquer ground with bold silver chrome sunburst), wide silver chrome bands following the contours of the body, dense zigzag linework filling the space between bands. Region 3 is the outermost region beyond the last ring: it is painted in Vasarely-inspired optical-illusion pattern (a repeating grid of squares bulging in a 3D illusion), wide silver bands following the contours of the body, dense optical illusion grid filling the space between bands. Where two regions meet, the patterns interlock naturally: motifs of one reach into the other and the two patterns simply touch, so the boundary is made only of the two neighbouring patterns, each in its own colours, with no gap between them. Each transition zone follows a smooth, even, perfectly circular course. Pigment on living skin throughout, covering every inch of her body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, face unpainted.

Left woman's pose: wide lunging stance, one leg forward, every region clearly visible to the camera.

Left woman's footwear: extreme platform stiletto heels, painted with the blended patterns following the same soft transitions as her skin.

Center woman: a real adult Spanish woman in her early 40s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, dramatic winged liner, a deep red lip, a passionate expression, warm olive skin, sultry, rich chocolate-brown hair styled in cornrows braided tight against the scalp, real living eyes. Long almond nails, glittery finish.

Center woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. A dramatically impossible waist-to-hip ratio dominates her silhouette: a colossal heavy bust, an extremely sharply cinched waist pulled in far tighter than the waistline of any of her other curves, and then enormous round hips flaring out to a width many times greater than that narrow waist. Gigantic soft thighs pressed together, very thick soft arms, a gigantic rounded rear. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Not a plus-size model, not evenly proportioned. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Center woman's body art: Her bare skin is painted with 3 different traditional patterns, each claiming its own region of her figure. Her figure is divided into 3 horizontal bands by 2 hazy transition zones centred about 28% of the way down her figure from the top and about 59% of the way down her figure from the top. Region 1 is everything above the first transition zone: it is painted in Yoruba adire eleko pattern (a deep indigo ground with bold cream resist-painted geometric motifs), wide cream bands following the contours of the body, dense geometric bird motifs filling the space between bands. Region 2 is the band between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it is painted in Hungarian Kalocsa folk painted motif (a deep black ground with bright red, pink and gold folk-art florals), wide gold bands following the contours of the body, dense folk-art floral motifs filling the space between bands. Region 3 is everything below the last transition zone: it is painted in Romanian Horezu ceramic (a cream ground with green, brown and ochre spiral floral motifs), wide ochre bands following the contours of the body, dense spiral floral bands filling the space between bands. Where two regions meet, the patterns interlock naturally: motifs of one reach into the other and the two patterns simply touch, so the boundary is made only of the two neighbouring patterns, each in its own colours, with no gap between them. Each transition zone follows a gently undulating wave, rising and falling softly, rather than a straight course. Pigment on living skin throughout, covering every inch of her body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, face unpainted.

Center woman's pose: mid-stride walking toward camera, every region clearly visible to the camera.

Center woman's footwear: extreme platform stiletto knee-high boots, painted with the blended patterns following the same soft transitions as her skin.

Composition: each woman's own pose as described, inner arms not crossing her neighbours, all faces toward the camera.

Lighting: the blended painted patterns reading crisp against each woman's skin, the hard raking light carving every fold and curve. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 3:4 8K.
